summary: Program mission schemas can declare kind-checked native resource inputs and receive subscription deliveries directly.

replay.detail: Resource observations remain pinned by the existing native subject and claim identity. No historical run or journal conversion.

schema.detail: MissionInputSpec adds optional resource_kind; KDL input declarations add optional resource-kind on kind=resource. Omitted constraints deserialize as absent and serialize without the field, preserving existing revision bytes.

rules.detail: Fractal.resourceInput(kind) schema fields lower to the existing native resource input convention. Shared run admission validates the resolved observation kind, including compact vcs.item.state item_kind, and refuses mismatches with resource-input-kind-mismatch before creating a run.

compatibility.detail: Existing unconstrained inputs retain their behavior. Older daemons cannot author the new KDL property and do not enforce the optional constraint in replicated structured revisions. Upgrade all possible run-admitting members before publishing constrained missions.

downtime.detail: No database migration or outage; sequence binary rollout before declaration publication.

manual.detail: Replace native dispatch bridges by resourceInput schema fields and repoint subscriptions to the program revision after upgrading admitting daemons. Keep existing subscription deduplication and immutable observation pins.

recovery.detail: Before downgrading admitting daemons, remove constrained declarations and drain their pending subscription requests; a downgrade otherwise loses kind enforcement.
